name: inspect_playwright_trace
description: Inspect a caller-selected Playwright v10 trace ZIP offline. No browser, replay or recorded-URL requests. Retains action boundaries, console text, network facts and screenshot/body references with archive/member/line identity. No cross-stream total order or complete-capture claim. Credentials use existing HAR/URL projection; context options, most action arguments/results, DOM and resource bytes are not analyzed. Default summary retains complete supported Evidence; view selects events/streams/members/diagnostics with batch IDs, fields and paging. Default text previews cover 256 UTF-16 units; event-text reads further exact text chunks and fields text returns the complete value. Archive/decoded-stream/fact allowances are 256/32/32 MiB; individual lines 4 MiB with bounded JSON node admission. One archive import is admitted at a time per decoder; retained views remain independent. Paging does not increase parsing allowances.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

path.description: Absolute path to an offline Playwright v10 trace ZIP

view.description: Return this selected page immediately; complete supported Evidence is retained
